label: MIG, Ø16 gas nozzle
notes: The nozzle the authoring side has always assumed: Ø16 across, 150 mm of barrel behind it. The range is what this gun is HELD at, not what the arithmetic permits -- under about 6 mm the nozzle is inside the groove, and past 25 mm the gas column is no longer covering the puddle. At 10 mm it cannot enter a groove tighter than 77°, so a 90° fillet is workable.
